field.source: Peter proposes Chakra-like Field and requests Radix comparison.

findings: Standalone Field connects control,label,helper,error via context/idrefs; vertical/horizontal layouts,requiredindicator/optional fallback,disabled/readonly/invalid.
Input consumes Ark Field.Input context. Plain arbitrary native/custom child is not automatically wired.
Field.Item provides scoped control IDs; target chooses parent label target in amount+currency example.
Field does not own values, validation engine or submission; error display controlled by invalid.
Helper uses aria-describedby; error uses aria-errormessage + polite live region; this is source behavior not house policy.
Fieldset disabled can supply default Field disabled; explicit props may override.

radix.completeReads: Form/Label/TextField docs, full implementation/CSS/prop/context helpers/Form and Label tests
findings: Form.Field requires Form.Root and stores name/id/serverInvalid; nativeControl owns required/disabled.
Form.Message registers description IDs, supports native/custom/server matches; no separate HelpText part.
Form docs warn Checkbox/Select primitives not currently composable; direct control API assumptions require Lit-specific bridge.
TextField is input/shell/slots, not shared labels/errors.
Async validation lacks cancellation/submit-wait gate; repeated-name state and external-form focus paths need verification; don't copy whole Form engine.

material.completeReads: all4 TextField tabs; both Default/Light token sets expanded; all16 static Specs figures;17TS and2SCSS implementation files
findings: Public filled/outlined Field shells own visuals; TextField owns input/form/validity and feeds state.
Mirrored description stays in input shadow root; visual error is separate from native validity.
Help-vs-error guidance conflicts; exact house error timing/message policy remains open.
Required/labels/icons/counters need semantic connection; field helper patches form methods with documented limitation; no automatic adoption.
material.limits: No runtime integration/assistive-tech tests; animation variants not exhaustively played; reference values remain separate from house.

findings: Horizontal Field in settings supports revisiting SettingRow.
Property panels compoundcontrols require explicit individual names; visible group title not enough.
No indexed ErrorText/RequiredIndicator examples, so use core docs for those.
No TanStack Form integration evidence in matched files.
No current acme-field.
Input owns internal label,error display and form value; publicField introduction needs deliberate migration, not duplicate owners.
External Label click-to-focus does not prove accessible naming across shadow roots.
Input addons currently labelled aria-hidden wrappers; interactive addon support requires inventory review.

field.recommendation: Add standalone semantic Field for label/control/help/error association and state presentation; preserve native-control value/validity and optional TanStack Form; Fieldset collection grouping remains distinct.
dependencies: Optional TanStack Form metadata and validation policy

decision.scope: Shared Field connects a control with its label, helper/error text, required/optional indication and horizontal/vertical layout. Control retains value/native validity; TanStack Form optional; Fieldset groups related controls.
decision.open: Exact properties/slots, supported composite controls, labeling across shadow roots, validation display timing, disabled-state inheritance and migration from existing embedded label/error properties remain for inventory.

list.source: Peter explicitly requests a component that works like Chakra List.
list.scope: Include a semantic List family in the planned inventory: ordered/unordered, marker/plain presentation, custom icon indicators, nested lists, configurable marker style/alignment and rich child content.
list.boundaries: No selection engine or automatic arrow navigation is supplied by Chakra List. Rich row presentation remains a separate current decision. Do not confuse List with Data List or listbox.
dependencies: native semantics through Lit shadow roots

materialList.sourceCoverage: Six List/List Item/controller/navigation TS files; two substantive SCSS files; two md-item TS files and SCSS; full reads
materialList.finding: Material separates md-item layout from md-list-item action and md-list collection navigation. Expressive guidance does not match every shipped baseline Lit behaviour.
materialList.limits: No house browser acceptance or adoption of Material measurements; animation/permutation coverage not claimed.
